question: On episodic-pivot (extreme-volume gap) events, does prior base length (consol_days) grade the outcome? Expect longer consol_days = better stop-R, since an EP breaking out of a longer, more mature base should be a stronger surprise catalyst.
plain: Idea: an episodic pivot (a big surprise-news gap) works better when the stock had been quietly building a base for a long time beforehand, versus one with no prior base.
